intro: The Pearl River Delta is the most interesting radio region in China because three separate regulatory systems overlap in a space you can drive across in two hours. Hong Kong licenses its own amateurs and keeps a lively analog repeater network; Macau is different again; the mainland side has four international airports feeding one of the densest terminal areas in Asia. The estuary itself is the busiest waterway in the world. Crossing a boundary here means changing the rules, not just the scenery.
introz: 珠三角是中国最有意思的无线电区域，因为三套彼此独立的管理体系重叠在一个两小时车程就能穿过的空间里。香港自行发放业余执照，并维持着相当活跃的模拟中继网络；澳门又是另一套；内地一侧有四座国际机场共用亚洲最密集的终端区之一。而珠江口本身是全球最繁忙的水域。在这里过境意味着规则变了，不只是风景变了。
warn: Hong Kong and Macau are separate radio jurisdictions from the mainland, with their own licensing and their own permitted bands. A mainland licence does not authorise you in Hong Kong and vice versa. Treat each boundary crossing as entering a different country.
warnz: 香港和澳门在无线电管理上与内地是彼此独立的辖区，各有自己的执照制度和可用频段。内地执照在香港无效，反之亦然。请把每一次过境都当作进入另一个国家。

stations.d: One of the world's great cargo and long-haul hubs, worked almost entirely in English. The approach over Lantau and the departure turns are excellent listening. Try from Tung Chung or the airport promenade.
stations.dz: 全球最重要的货运与远程枢纽之一，几乎全程英文通话。经大屿山的进近和离场转弯很值得听。可在东涌或机场观景长廊尝试。

stations.d: Only about twenty kilometres from Hong Kong's airport, which is why the delta's airspace has to be coordinated across the boundary.
stations.dz: 距香港机场仅约二十公里，这正是珠三角空域必须跨境协调的原因。

stations.d: Four major airports in one basin. Enroute sectors here are among the most saturated in Asia.
stations.dz: 一个盆地里四座大型机场。这里的航路扇区是亚洲最饱和的之一。

stations.z: 海事 16 频道 · 遇险与呼叫
stations.d: The busiest stretch of water on the planet. Container ships, hydrofoil ferries to Macau, river barges, pilots and both the Hong Kong Marine Department and the mainland Maritime Safety Administration. Outstanding from Victoria Harbour, Tsim Sha Tsui or the Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macau bridge.
stations.dz: 全球最繁忙的一段水域：集装箱船、往澳门的喷射船、内河驳船、引航员，以及香港海事处和内地海事局。在维多利亚港、尖沙咀或港珠澳大桥一带收听效果出色。

stations.z: 船舶交通管理 12 频道
stations.d: Hong Kong and mainland VTS both operate here on separate channel assignments. Scan 156.300–156.800 to find whichever sector you are in.
stations.dz: 香港与内地的船舶交通管理在这里各用不同频道。扫 156.300–156.800 找你所在分区的频道。

stations.z: 海事 06 频道 · 船间通话

stations.d: Hong Kong has a long-established amateur community with VR2 callsigns and a well-maintained analog repeater network on hilltops like Tai Mo Shan and Mount Parker. Coverage across the harbour is genuinely good.
stations.dz: 香港有历史悠久的业余无线电群体，使用 VR2 呼号，在大帽山、柏架山等山顶维护着一套完善的模拟中继网络，全港覆盖相当不错。

stations.z: 中继台下行 · 扫 430–440 MHz
stations.d: Both Hong Kong and mainland repeaters are audible across the boundary, on different band-plan conventions. Sweeping the whole 430–440 MHz block from a hilltop is the practical approach.
stations.dz: 香港和内地的中继台在边界两侧都能收到，但遵循不同的频段规划惯例。在山顶把 430–440 MHz 整段扫一遍是最实际的做法。

stations.z: 公众对讲机 · 内地一侧
stations.d: Extremely busy in Shenzhen and Guangzhou: electronics markets, logistics parks, construction and site security. Note this band is a mainland allocation — Hong Kong's licence-free arrangements differ.
stations.dz: 在深圳和广州极其繁忙：电子市场、物流园、工地和场地保安。注意这是内地的频率划分——香港的免执照安排不同。

stations.n: Police and fire on both sides — digital
stations.z: 两地警消 · 数字制式
stations.d: Mainland public security runs encrypted PDT; Hong Kong's police moved to a digital trunked system years ago. Neither is receivable on an analog handheld.
stations.dz: 内地公安使用加密 PDT；香港警队多年前已迁到数字集群系统。模拟手台都收不到。

stations.z: 香港电台第四台 · 古典音乐
stations.d: Bilingual classical service. Hong Kong stations use several transmitter frequencies across the territory because of the terrain, so the exact number depends where you are standing.
stations.dz: 双语古典频道。由于地形关系，香港电台在全港使用多个发射频率，具体数字取决于你所在的位置。

stations.z: 香港电台第三台 · 英文

stations.d: This is the most crowded FM band in the region. Standing in Shenzhen you receive Hong Kong stations and vice versa, in Cantonese, Mandarin, English and Portuguese from Macau. Genuinely worth an unhurried hour.
stations.dz: 这是本区最拥挤的调频波段。站在深圳能收到香港的台，反之也一样，粤语、普通话、英语，还有澳门的葡语。真的值得花一小时慢慢听。

stations.z: 无线列调 · 普速线路
